title: A Statistical Analysis of Three Player Auction Bridge
summary: Three-player Auction Bridge is a finite imperfect-information game in which dynamic partnerships create a distinctive interaction between scoring, strategic incentives, and payoff distribution. This paper develops a unified statistical and game-theoretic framework to evaluate a traditional scoring rule against a modified mechanism designed to improve strategic incentives. We first identify a structural defect in the original scheme: a bid-invariant slam bonus can make lower contracts strictly more attractive than higher ones.
